# n-segmented-control

> Segmented control with a sliding indicator for single-value selection.

**Class:** `NSegmentedControl`

**ARIA role:** `radiogroup`
**Form-associated:** yes (participates in `<form>` submission, reset, validation)
**Internal controllers:** `PressController`, `ListNavigateController`

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `value` | `string` |  | Currently selected segment value |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Disables all segments |
| `name` | `string` |  | Form field name |
| `required` | `string` |  |  |

## CSS Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Values | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|-------------|
| `pressed` | boolean | _(boolean)_ | Present while a segment is being pressed |
| `inline` | boolean | _(boolean)_ | Shrinks control to fit content width |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
|-------|--------|-------------|
| `native:change` | _(none)_ | Fired when selection changes with `{ value, label }` detail |

## Accessibility

- **Role:** `radiogroup`
- **Form-associated:** participates in form submission, reset, and validation

### Keyboard

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `ArrowRight` | Moves selection to the next segment |
| `ArrowLeft` | Moves selection to the previous segment |

## Behavior

- **click on segment** → Selects segment and fires native:change with value and label

## Composition

### Children
- `<n-segment>`

### Parents
- `<n-field>`
- `<n-toolbar>`

## Usage

### Minimal

```html
<n-segmented-control></n-segmented-control>
```

### Examples

```html
<n-segmented-control value="month">
        <n-segment value="day">Day</n-segment>
        <n-segment value="week">Week</n-segment>
        <n-segment value="month">Month</n-segment>
        <n-segment value="year">Year</n-segment>
      </n-segmented-control>
```

```html
<n-segmented-control size="xs" value="a">
          <n-segment value="a">Alpha</n-segment>
          <n-segment value="b">Beta</n-segment>
          <n-segment value="c">Gamma</n-segment>
        </n-segmented-control>
```

```html
<n-segmented-control size="sm" value="a">
          <n-segment value="a">Alpha</n-segment>
          <n-segment value="b">Beta</n-segment>
          <n-segment value="c">Gamma</n-segment>
        </n-segmented-control>
```
